notes:
Ford announced Mach-E LFP shift in May-2023 (Ford press release; Reuters
coverage). 2024-MY Mach-E SR and select 2023-MY late-build SR units
shipped with CATL LFP prismatic cells imported from Changshu (China).
This is the same Changshu LFP line that supplies CATL's prismatic LFP
to multiple OEMs; Ford-bound volumes ship as packs / modules to
Cuautitlán for final pack assembly + vehicle build.

Pack kWh: Ford's own US spec sheet for 2024-MY Mach-E SR RWD shows
72 kWh usable (~70 kWh nominal). Pre-2023 SR was 68 kWh NMC.

IRA 30D status (2024): Mach-E SR LOST eligibility for the $7,500
credit beginning Jan-2024 because CATL is FEOC-affiliated. This is
a confirmation of the CATL relationship (only reason for credit loss).

notes:
Ford 2023 Integrated Sustainability Report names LGES as the cell
supplier for Mach-E (NMC pouch). LGES Holland (Michigan) is the
historical primary plant for Mach-E ER through 2023; LGES Wroclaw
(Poland) supplied earlier Mach-E ER builds and continues partial
backstop for Mexico-bound packs alongside Holland.

Pack architecture: the Mach-E ER pack uses LGES large-format pouch
cells (the same family used by other Ford EVs prior to BlueOval SK
Tennessee online date). Cuautitlán performs final pack assembly for
both SR and ER trims, with cells / modules shipped in.

IRA 30D status (2024): Mach-E ER retained PARTIAL credit ($3,750)
under 2024 critical minerals + battery components rules; Ford 2024
IRA filing is the public attestation. Loss of half the credit reflects
partial FEOC-affiliated upstream content (e.g. some Chinese refining
steps in LGES Ni / Co supply chain).

NOTE: SK On / BlueOval SK Commerce GA plant is for F-150 Lightning,
NOT Mach-E. Do not confuse. (Out of scope here.)
